REMOVED FROM COURT TRIAL CALENDAR ON AUG-26-2002 IN DEPT. 624 - APPEARANCE BY PLAINTIFF COUNSEL. NO APPEARANCE BY DEFENDANT. PROVE-UP HEARING PROCEEDED. WITNESS SWORN AND EXAMINED. DOCUMENTARY EVIDENCE INTRODUCED. HAVING HEARD THE EVIDENCE, THE COURT ORDERED JUDGMENT IN FAVOR OF THE PLAINTIFF FORSHAW PROPERTIES, A CALIFONRIA LIMITED PARTNERSHIP TO RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT DANIEL DAVID LUNT, THE RESTITUTION AND POSSESSION OF THE PREMISES SITUATED AT 2600 VAN NESS AVENUE, #605 AND PARKING SPACES 1, 2A & 2B, SAN FRANCISCO, CA. IT WAS FURTHER ORDERED THAT PLAINTIFF RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT THE SUM OF $2,114.56 BACK RENT ($1,950.78 FOR 2600 VAN NESS AVE., #605 AND $163.78 FOR PARKING SPACES), $4,157.14 UNLAWFUL DETAINER DAMAGES ($3,836.18 FOR 2600 VAN NESS AVE., #605 AND $320.96 FOR THE PARKING SPACES) FOR A TOTAL SUM OF $6,271.70, COSTS AND $35.23 ($32.51 FOR 2600 VAN NESS AVE., #605 AND $2.72 FOR PARKING SPACES) PER DIEM HOLDOVER. LEASE FORFEITED. EXHIBITS ORDERED RETURNED TO PLAINTIFF COUNSEL IN OPEN COURT. JUDGMENT SIGNED IN OPEN COURT. JUDGE BOULIANE; CLERK: V. MU; REPORTER: D. LUBIN, #3234 (624)
